closure.cast: For positive n/d, repeated removal acts only while n/d exceeds the One; termination leaves an exact part in (0, One], and an exact whole terminates at the One.
closure.exactness: Integer pairs reduce through the host Fraction carrier; no decimal, irrational or imaginary proof value is constructible.
closure.fold: For an admitted part x, x joined to itself lies in (0, two Ones]; casting therefore returns exactly one admitted part.
closure.generality: The numerator/denominator arguments apply to every admitted finite positive count pair, not a chosen denominator bound.
closure.minimality: Removing a guard, cast convention, closure, unison or trace loses a required invariant; adding an operation is unforced.
closure.take: For admitted a>b, the guarded difference is strictly positive and smaller than the One.
closure.unison: The positive relation a/a is exactly the One; coincidence is identity, not a numerical zero.

controls.observed_behavior: the exact carrier raises before constructing a forbidden part

controls.expected_behavior: reject a full turn represented as absence
controls.observed_behavior: casting two Ones returns the One
